subject: general
question: Abdul Karim Khan and Abdul Wahid Khan were the founders of the ______ gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kirana Gharana is one of Hindustan's most prolific Khayal Gharana.
 
• The name of this music school stems from Kirana or Kairana in Uttar Pradesh's Shamli region, which is also the hometown of stalwarts like Ustad Abdul Karim Khan and Ustad Abdul Waheed Khan who founded this Gharana.
 
• The Kirana style is primarily concerned with Swara, or individual notes, specifically precision tuning and note expression.
 
• Individual notes of the raga are regarded as autonomous domains of music capable of horizontal growth in the Kirana Gayaki, not merely random positions in the scale.
 
• It is regarded as the best in terms of a note or Swara intonation
 
• The major emphasis of the Kirana style is Swara, namely exact tuning and note expression.
 
• There were four schools or vanis of singing the dhrupad.
